doc.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-04-02

title: Picture of De De's family
summary: They look at a photo of De De at about twelve with his parents, brother and sister; one of nine children.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Now here's the family picture of D.D. now. Oh yes, this is D.D.'s family.
Yes, yeah. Now wait a minute, is this D.D. here?
That's right. Yeah, looks like him. What's left to him? Yeah, he's pretty, about maybe 12 years old or something there. God knows.
That's the one standing with the father and mother, yeah. All together? Yeah.
Oh yeah. And that's his brother. You can see the resemblance.
That's his sister, and that's his brother. Nice looking family, isn't it, Rob?
Sure is. Very nice. We were nine though.
